properties.name: A served skill walks a person through designing a phenomenon and the experiment that tests it, composing what exists (lines of reasoning, calc records, the study designed up front), written from what the sinogram trial shows it needs
properties.statement: A served skill ("design a phenomenon", or a name the trial suggests) walks a person and their chat through laying out what is observed or hypothesized, the model and each assumption with the regime where it holds, the derivation from model to a predicted observable (steps checked where calc can, conditions stated where it cannot), the predicted numbers with their uncertainty as calc records, rival models, and the experiment that would tell them apart (handing the test itself to the study-designed-up-front skill), as one line of reasoning a paper's sections can be read from. It composes existing records and skills; it adds no new record type. It is written AFTER the sinogram reconstruction trial (option d), from what that trial shows such a design needs.
